meaning.en: Something that falls within one's own duty.
meaning.zh: 本分以内应该做的事。

examples.zh: 帮助病人是医生的分内之事。
examples.en: Helping patients is simply part of a doctor's job.

examples.zh: 别客气，这是我的分内之事。
examples.en: Don't mention it — it's all in a day's work.

usage.en: Object; often a modest reply to thanks. 分 is read fèn.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常用作受谢时的谦辞。“分”读fèn。

meaning.en: The crucial stroke that brings a work to life (from the story of painting in a dragon's eyes).
meaning.zh: 比喻文章或作品中最精彩、最关键的部分（源自“画龙点睛”）。

examples.zh: 文章的结尾是全篇的点睛之笔。
examples.en: The ending is the crowning touch of the whole essay.

examples.zh: 这盏吊灯是整个客厅设计的点睛之笔。
examples.en: The chandelier is the finishing touch to the living room.

usage.en: Object, often 是……的点睛之笔.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“是……的点睛之笔”。

meaning.en: Burning with anger inside.
meaning.zh: 怒火在心中燃烧，形容非常愤怒。

examples.zh: 看到孩子被欺负，他怒火中烧。
examples.en: Seeing his child bullied, he was seething with rage.

examples.zh: 她强压着怒火中烧的情绪，保持微笑。
examples.en: Burning with anger, she forced herself to keep smiling.

meaning.en: Never to have met before.
meaning.zh: 从来没有见过面。

examples.zh: 我们虽然素未谋面，但通信多年。
examples.en: Although we've never met, we've corresponded for years.

examples.zh: 一位素未谋面的网友帮了他大忙。
examples.en: An online friend he had never met helped him enormously.

meaning.en: To set up on one's own, independent of the group one belonged to.
meaning.zh: 脱离原来的集体，自己另外成立门户。

examples.zh: 他在大公司干了十年，后来自立门户。
examples.en: After ten years at a big firm, he struck out on his own.

examples.zh: 这位厨师离开名店，自立门户开了餐馆。
examples.en: The chef left the famous restaurant and opened his own place.

meaning.en: Dazzlingly bright and beautiful.
meaning.zh: 光泽和色彩非常鲜艳耀眼。

examples.zh: 橱窗里的珠宝光彩夺目。
examples.en: The jewellery in the window is dazzling.

examples.zh: 她在颁奖典礼上光彩夺目。
examples.en: She looked stunning at the awards ceremony.

meaning.en: Completely indifferent.
meaning.zh: 完全不放在心上。

examples.zh: 被老师批评后，他还是一副满不在乎的样子。
examples.en: Even after being told off, he looked as if he couldn't care less.

examples.zh: 她对别人的议论满不在乎。
examples.en: She's completely unbothered by what others say.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often 一副满不在乎的样子.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常说“一副满不在乎的样子”。

synonyms: 死猪不怕开水烫——满不在乎

meaning.en: One chosen from a hundred; outstanding.
meaning.zh: 从一百个里挑出一个，形容极为出众。

examples.zh: 她是百里挑一的好姑娘。
examples.en: She's one in a million.

examples.zh: 能进这所学校的学生都是百里挑一。
examples.en: Students who get into this school are the cream of the crop.

meaning.en: Having both advantages and disadvantages.
meaning.zh: 既有好处也有坏处。

examples.zh: 使用手机学习有利有弊。
examples.en: Using phones to study has pros and cons.

examples.zh: 任何政策都有利有弊，关键是权衡。
examples.en: Every policy cuts both ways — the key is weighing them up.

meaning.en: Drowsy and muddle-headed.
meaning.zh: 头脑昏沉，神志不清。

examples.zh: 吃了感冒药，他整天昏昏沉沉的。
examples.en: After the cold medicine he was groggy all day.

examples.zh: 熬夜之后，第二天上课昏昏沉沉。
examples.en: After staying up late, I was drowsy in class the next day.

meaning.en: Fond of grandiose projects and quick glory.
meaning.zh: 一心想做大事，立大功，多指浮夸冒进。

examples.zh: 这位官员好大喜功，搞了很多形象工程。
examples.en: The official was a glory-seeker who built endless vanity projects.

examples.zh: 创业不能好大喜功，要稳扎稳打。
examples.en: In a start-up, don't chase glory — build steadily.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; critical. 好 is read hào.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，含贬义。“好”读hào。

meaning.en: A family broken up and scattered.
meaning.zh: 妻子儿女分散，形容家庭破散。

examples.zh: 战争让无数家庭妻离子散。
examples.en: War tore countless families apart.

examples.zh: 他赌博欠债，最后落得妻离子散。
examples.en: His gambling debts left him with his family scattered.

meaning.en: To put Zhang's hat on Li; to attribute something to the wrong person or confuse two things.
meaning.zh: 把姓张的帽子戴到姓李的头上，比喻弄错了对象或事实。

equivalents: get the wrong end of the stick

examples.zh: 这句名言你张冠李戴了，不是鲁迅说的。
examples.en: You've misattributed that quote — it wasn't Lu Xun who said it.

examples.zh: 写论文时引文不能张冠李戴。
examples.en: In a dissertation, never mix up your citations.

meaning.en: Without a sound; also unknown, with no impact.
meaning.zh: 没有声音，没有气息；也比喻默默无闻，没有影响。

examples.zh: 猫无声无息地溜进了厨房。
examples.en: The cat slipped into the kitchen without a sound.

examples.zh: 那个项目就这样无声无息地结束了。
examples.en: The project just quietly fizzled out.

meaning.en: To worry endlessly about personal gain and loss.
meaning.zh: 担心得不到，得到了又担心失去，形容过分计较个人得失。

examples.zh: 他做事总是患得患失，错过了很多机会。
examples.en: He's always fretting over what he might lose, and has missed many chances.

examples.zh: 考试时别患得患失，放松心态。
examples.en: Don't agonise during the exam — just relax.

story.en: Confucius on the petty man: before he has a post, he worries about getting it; once he has it, he worries about losing it.
story.zh: 《论语·阳货》：“其未得之也，患得之；既得之，患失之。苟患失之，无所不至矣。”

antonyms: 君子坦荡荡，小人长戚戚

meaning.en: Orders coming from many different authorities, causing confusion.
meaning.zh: 政令出自许多部门，令人无所适从。

examples.zh: 政出多门导致企业审批流程繁琐。
examples.en: With so many bodies issuing rules, approvals for businesses are a nightmare.

examples.zh: 要改变政出多门、各自为政的局面。
examples.en: We must end the situation of overlapping authorities each going its own way.

usage.en: Predicate or subject; news and policy writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、主语，多用于新闻、政论。

meaning.en: To think oneself clever and act rashly.
meaning.zh: 自以为聪明而乱出主意或乱做事。

examples.zh: 他自作聪明改了程序，结果系统崩溃了。
examples.en: Being too clever by half, he changed the code and crashed the system.

examples.zh: 别自作聪明，按规定办事。
examples.en: Don't try to be clever — follow the rules.

meaning.en: Overwhelmed and surprised at unexpected kindness or favour.
meaning.zh: 受到意外的宠爱而感到又惊又喜。

examples.zh: 总经理亲自打电话来，他受宠若惊。
examples.en: When the managing director phoned him personally, he was quite overwhelmed.

examples.zh: 您这么夸我，我真是受宠若惊。
examples.en: Such praise — I'm truly flattered.

usage.en: Predicate; also a modest reply to praise.

story.en: Laozi says 'favour makes one low: gaining it, one is as if startled; losing it, one is as if startled' (宠为下，得之若惊，失之若惊), warning that being favoured disturbs one's peace. 受宠若惊 condenses the 'startled by favour' half.
story.zh: 《老子》第十三章：“宠为下，得之若惊，失之若惊。”意谓得宠失宠都使人惊惶不安；“受宠若惊”取其“得之若惊”之意。

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前3世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–3rd c. BC

meaning.en: To depart from this world forever; to die (euphemistic).
meaning.zh: 永远离开人世，指去世（婉辞）。

examples.zh: 这位著名作家昨日与世长辞，享年九十岁。
examples.en: The renowned author passed away yesterday at the age of ninety.

examples.zh: 老人在睡梦中安详地与世长辞。
examples.en: The old man passed away peacefully in his sleep.

usage.en: Predicate; respectful euphemism, used in obituaries and news.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；婉辞，多用于讣告、新闻。

meaning.en: To straighten one's clothes and sit upright, solemn and respectful.
meaning.zh: 整理好衣襟，端正地坐着，形容严肃或拘谨。

examples.zh: 面试时，他正襟危坐，十分紧张。
examples.en: At the interview he sat bolt upright, very nervous.

examples.zh: 学生们正襟危坐，等待校长讲话。
examples.en: The pupils sat up straight, waiting for the head teacher to speak.

story.en: Song Zhong and Jia Yi, struck by the diviner Sima Ji's words, adjusted their caps and 'straightened their robes and sat upright'.
story.zh: 《史记·日者列传》：“宋忠、贾谊瞿然而悟，猎缨正襟危坐。”

meaning.en: Excessive formalities and rituals.
meaning.zh: 过多的礼节和仪式，比喻繁琐多余的事项。

examples.zh: 婚礼办得简单点，免去那些繁文缛节。
examples.en: Keep the wedding simple and skip all the fuss and ceremony.

examples.zh: 政府部门应减少繁文缛节，提高效率。
examples.en: Government departments should cut red tape and become more efficient.

meaning.en: To blow apart the fur looking for blemishes; to nitpick.
meaning.zh: 吹开皮上的毛寻找毛病，比喻故意挑剔别人的缺点。

examples.zh: 他对下属的报告总是吹毛求疵。
examples.en: He always nitpicks his staff's reports.

examples.zh: 这是吹毛求疵，根本不是问题。
examples.en: That's just splitting hairs — it isn't a problem at all.

story.en: Hanfeizi: the wise ruler 'does not blow apart the hair to look for small flaws' (不吹毛而求小疵).
story.zh: 《韩非子·大体》：“不吹毛而求小疵，不洗垢而察难知。”

date.en: end of Warring States, 3rd c. BC

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 疵 is read cī.

synonyms: 鸡蛋里挑骨头——百般挑剔
antonyms: 水至清则无鱼，人至察则无徒

meaning.en: Blotting out the sky and the sun; dense or vast.
meaning.zh: 遮住天空和太阳，形容数量多、面积大或枝叶茂密。

examples.zh: 沙尘暴来时，黄沙遮天蔽日。
examples.en: When the sandstorm hit, the dust blotted out the sun.

examples.zh: 林中古树参天，遮天蔽日。
examples.en: The towering old trees blotted out the sky.
